note: Fresh source views exported from the current model with no car. Final images use each exact 3D view for a geometry-preserving material and lighting pass. Exploratory outputs using a private garage photograph were rejected when they changed shelving. Final outputs were compared against the source views. The model fingerprint identifies the working-tree geometry; the base commit is provenance, not the final design commit. Generated details are illustrative; source dimensions govern.

plans.label: A · Walls + loft
plans.prompt:
Make a PHOTOREALISTIC MATERIAL PASS on the attached exact 3D garage reference. This is a locked engineering visualization: the geometry is already designed. Preserve every structural and furniture edge, camera position, perspective and occlusion of the source. Do not reconstruct or redesign the room. No text or UI.
Only improve physical material appearance, surface grain, lighting and softness of existing depicted belongings. Preserve exactly all shelf planes and their front/back edges and depths, the number of levels, every frame/upright/bracket, diagonal braces, narrow wall ledges, charger and cable, loft beams and deck, ladder, folded chairs/table, skis, one steering snow racer. White triangular voids at roof edges can stay pale neutral; do not invent construction to cover them. The apparent small size of the rear wall must remain exactly unchanged. Do not zoom, crop, straighten or shift viewpoint.
Left-wall small shelves are recessed: their BACKS stay behind the studs. Keep EACH of them at exactly the source location and size. Do not stretch them to adjacent bays, remove any, turn them into wire baskets, or add a connecting rail. Where the upper left/right shelf has a GAP in the source, KEEP THE GAP. There is NOT a continuous upper perimeter shelf unless visibly present. Do not place bags along bare stud tops. Do not add any new shelf, cabinet, rail, rack, beam, wall panel or furniture.
Use natural warm unfinished pine, realistic fine grain, subtle knots, gently worn clean concrete, real black metal and steel. Bright but soft natural entrance daylight with realistic bounce. Make the existing simple bag shapes into compact realistic soft bags without increasing their silhouette. The existing snow racer must retain its steering wheel and single central front ski, not become a bundle of skis. Keep all existing empty shelves EMPTY so geometry is easy to compare. Do not add loose objects, boxes, backpacks or extra skis. No car or people. Clean, calm real garage photography, but exact source structure takes absolute precedence over styling.
plans.review: Six recessed two-tray units, seven rear wall boards, four separate upper-left boards, no freestanding rear rack. Compared side by side with the fresh source: upper-run gaps, recess locations, rear depth, right ski shelf, ladder, one sled and loft retained. Geometry-changing drafts rejected.
